chunks: ʿAbdullāh ibn Sinān narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
It is not for the muhrim to marry, nor to marry off one who is not in ihram. So if he marries or marries off, then his marriage contract is invalid.

key_terms.تَزْوِيجُهُ: his act of contracting or conducting the marriage
key_terms.مُحِلًّا: one who is not in the state of ihram
key_terms.يُزَوِّجَ: to give someone in marriage or officiate a marriage
key_terms.ٱلْمُحْرِمِ: a person in the state of ihram during hajj or ʿumrah

ai.seo_question: Can a person in ihram perform a marriage or get married during hajj or ʿumrah?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling that a person in the state of ihram may neither contract a marriage for himself nor officiate a marriage for another who is not in ihram. If such a marriage is conducted during ihram, the contract is invalid.
